column1: # One slow shallow curve drawn by hand on a Wacom DTH246 pen display
# Scribble.WinUINative on the Wintab hi-res digitizer context.
# The first recording in this repository taken on real hardware with a time column
# only measurement of Wintab's pkTime that exists: 1683 points
# of 5ms or 6ms averaging 5555us for a 180 Hz device. No repeats
# Pressure confirms the DTH246 resolves in steps of 4 across its declared 0..32767 range
# 8192 levels rather than 32767: 99.7% of the gaps between distinct pressures are multiples

column2: and the smallest step is exactly 4. Reproduced here on a different code path from the
